rationale: Newly redrawn TN-9 drew a two-legislator GOP primary (Taylor vs Warner); Taylor self-funded $1M with endorsements from both TN senators (Blackburn, Hagerty), Burchett, Scalise and Knox County Mayor Jacobs; no Trump endorsement found as of Jun 24.
11-candidate field; Civic Clarity/Change Research (June 11-15) poll shows Hamilton leading at 18% with Davis second; Hamilton has high name ID as pastor of the largest UMC congregation.
El-Sayed leads all recent polls (Mitchell June 11-13: 42% vs Stevens 33%, McMorrow 6%; RCP avg El-Sayed 24%, Stevens/McMorrow 20%).

Trump endorsed Ogles and GOP lawmakers redrew TN-5 at Trump's/White House request to blunt challengers; Ogles beat a well-funded 2024 primary challenger 56.5-43.5, but Hatcher out-raised him and has Wamp's backing.
Peak Insights poll (June 8-9) has Rep. Marques at 30%, McKee 10%, others single digits; no-runoff plurality special primary with 42% undecided.
Mills is the Trump-endorsed incumbent who beat Johnson in 2024 but faces sexual misconduct/ethics scandals, only ~$115k cash and $2M debt; former Fox 35 anchor Ryan Elijah is a credible challenger.
Only Angie Nixon and Alex Vindman qualified; Vindman has raised $8.2M vs Nixon's $294k and has broad endorsements.
Makary resigned May 12; Kyle Diamantas is acting but reportedly not interested; CNN reported former FDA commissioner Ned Sharpless under consideration; no nominee announced as of Jun 24.
AIPAC tensions rising in GOP races (Hillsborough GOP congressional debate, Alabama primary); no specific Senate-candidate reporting found by Jun 24, spread across leading Republican Senate nominees.

MAGA Inc. has ~$356M on hand and no major 2026 general buys yet (only $1.7M in specials); LaCivita called Texas an open seat 'we'll have to ensure that we win,' while NC and OH are biggest Senate battlegrounds.
No reporting of such a request as of Jun 24; guess among GOP senators willing to criticize Trump-world, especially outspoken Judiciary members or retiring senators.
